items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: He was David Bowie’s conductor for, I don’t know, forever.

ctx.x: Yeah I had one. I auditioned with Horace Silver. He just died by the way. Randy Brecker was on the band, Bennie Maupin, I can’t remember the bass player, and Horace. And so

they were holding auditions up at Lynn Oliver’s studio. Mike Garson got me the audition. He was David Bowie’s conductor for, I don’t know, forever. And I went up there and I played first. And I was the only white guy auditioning on drums. Billy Cobham was leaving and a replacement was being held for him. I mean auditions were taking place. And one guy played, a black guy played. And he wasn’t particularly good. He wasn’t very good. But Horace was nice about it, and let him play a couple of tunes. Then called me…
